title: Persona-vector early warning: catching emergent misalignment before it generalizes

original_idea.body: Test whether projection onto an off-the-shelf toxic-persona vector, measured only on narrow training-domain data, predicts broad emergent misalignment.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Early-warning monitor for emergent misalignment targets a stark, recognized critical safety pathway; deliverable independently useful.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Tiny LoRA to induce narrow misalignment + persona-vector projection AUC is guided; novice + mentor feasible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable but requires creating/obtaining a misaligned fine-tune plus the projection-predicts-misalignment test.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Lab-independent monitor for fine-tuning pipelines; emergent misalignment is exactly the neglected work labs deprioritize.

low_compute.reasoning: Tiny LoRA + inference projection on a small model; single GPU days.

novelty.reasoning: Persona vectors controlling emergent misalignment is published; the early-warning-projection monitor framing is partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Persona-vector control of emergent misalignment is published; using the projection as an early-warning monitor is a partly-open framing.
